errEnded: Your free week has ended, so Horizon is view-only. Subscribe to make changes again.
errDailyLimit: You have used today's {limit} free changes. Subscribe for unlimited changes, or come back tomorrow.
bannerEnded: Your free week has ended. Horizon is view-only for now.
title: Keep Horizon unlimited
intro: Everyone gets {days} days free, with {limit} changes a day. After that, subscribe to keep making changes. Seeing, downloading and deleting your data always stay free.
statusEndedBody: Viewing, downloading and deleting your data still work. Subscribe to import, correct and plan again.
endsOn: Ends on {date}. It will not renew.
whatCounts: A change is an import, a correction, a goal, a linked bank, a transfer or a card colour. Undoing a correction or deleting a goal never counts.
included2: Every bank in one place, in its own currency
included3: Cancel any time; access lasts to the end of the paid period
testMode: Test mode: no real money is charged.
pendingBody: Started a payment? It can take a minute to show here.
stillPending: No payment yet. If you just paid, wait a minute and check again.
cancelConfirm: Cancel your subscription? You keep everything until {date}.
errNotReady: Subscriptions are not switched on yet. Please try again later.
errStart: Could not open the payment page. Try again.
errTooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes.
errNothing: There is no subscription to change.
errInProgress: A payment page is already opening. Wait a moment.
codeHint: A promo code, or a friend's referral code. One code per account.
codeApplied: Done: {days} free days added. Horizon is yours until {date}.
codeUnknown: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
codeUsedUp: That code has been used as many times as it allows.
codeOwn: That is your own referral code: share it with someone else.
codeAlready: This account has already used a code.
codeSubscribed: You are subscribed already, so free days would not change anything.
referralBody: Share it. When someone enters it on their Plans page, you both get {days} days of Horizon free.
paySuccessBody: Thank you. Horizon is unlimited for you now; the Plans page shows when it renews.
payFailBody: Nothing was charged. You can try again whenever you like.
payPendingBody: Razorpay confirmed the payment but the plan has not switched yet. It usually takes a minute: press 'check again' on the Plans page.
payNotConfirmed: We could not confirm that payment. If money was taken, press 'I have paid: check again'.
